passages.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
David gave this psalm to the choirmaster.
The choirmaster leads music in worship.
This psalm is for use in worship.

passages.text: Rescue me, O LORD, from evil men. Protect me from men of violence, who devise evil in their hearts and stir up war all day long.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm for the choirmaster.
David speaks to the LORD.
David says, “Rescue me, LORD, from evil men.”
David asks God to protect him from violent men.
These men plan evil in their hearts.
They stir up war every day.
passages.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃ חַלְּצֵ֣נִי יְ֭הוָה מֵאָדָ֣ם רָ֑ע מֵאִ֖ישׁ חֲמָסִ֣ים תִּנְצְרֵֽנִי׃ אֲשֶׁ֤ר חָשְׁב֣וּ רָע֣וֹת בְּלֵ֑ב כָּל־ י֝֗וֹם יָג֥וּרוּ מִלְחָמֽוֹת׃

passages.text: They sharpen their tongues like snakes; the venom of vipers is on their lips. Selah Guard me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked. Keep me safe from men of violence who scheme to make me stumble.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
He prayed to the LORD.
Evil men threatened him.
Violent men planned to harm him.
These men sharpen their tongues like snakes.
Their words are like the venom of vipers.
Venom hides under their lips.
Selah.
David asked the LORD to guard him.
He asked God to protect him from the hands of the wicked.
He asked God to keep him safe from violent men.
These men scheme to make him stumble.
passages.original: שָֽׁנֲנ֣וּ לְשׁוֹנָם֮ כְּֽמוֹ־ נָ֫חָ֥שׁ חֲמַ֥ת עַכְשׁ֑וּב תַּ֖חַת שְׂפָתֵ֣ימוֹ סֶֽלָה׃ שָׁמְרֵ֤נִי יְהוָ֨ה׀ מִ֘ידֵ֤י רָשָׁ֗ע מֵאִ֣ישׁ חֲמָסִ֣ים תִּנְצְרֵ֑נִי אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָ֝שְׁב֗וּ לִדְח֥וֹת פְּעָמָֽי׃

passages.text: The proud hide a snare for me; the cords of their net are spread along the path, and lures are set out for me. Selah I say to the LORD, “You are my God.” Hear, O LORD, my cry for help.
passages.sermon:
The proud set a trap for me.
They hide a snare to catch me.
They spread cords of their net along my path.
They place lures beside the road to make me fall.
Selah.
I speak to the LORD.
I say, "You are my God."
LORD, listen to my cry for help.
Hear my prayer.
passages.original: טָֽמְנֽוּ־ גֵאִ֨ים׀ פַּ֡ח לִ֗י וַחֲבָלִ֗ים פָּ֣רְשׂוּ רֶ֭שֶׁת לְיַד־ מַעְגָּ֑ל מֹקְשִׁ֖ים שָֽׁתוּ־ לִ֣י סֶֽלָה׃ אָמַ֣רְתִּי לַ֭יהוָה אֵ֣לִי אָ֑תָּה הַאֲזִ֥ינָה יְ֝הוָ֗ה ק֣וֹל תַּחֲנוּנָֽי׃

passages.text: O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, You shield my head in the day of battle.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD is my Master.
The LORD gives me strength.
The LORD saves me.
The LORD protects my head.
The LORD shields me in battle.
passages.original: יְהֹוִ֣ה אֲ֭דֹנָי עֹ֣ז יְשׁוּעָתִ֑י סַכֹּ֥תָה לְ֝רֹאשִׁ֗י בְּי֣וֹם נָֽשֶׁק׃

passages.text: Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked; do not promote their evil plans, lest they be exalted. Selah May the heads of those who surround me be covered in the trouble their lips have caused.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD has power over all people.
Wicked people have evil desires.
Do not give the wicked what they want, LORD.
Do not let their evil plans succeed.
If their plans succeed, they will become proud.
Selah.
Many people surround me.
They speak harmful words.
Let the trouble from their own words cover their heads.
passages.original: אַל־ תִּתֵּ֣ן יְ֭הוָה מַאֲוַיֵּ֣י רָשָׁ֑ע זְמָמ֥וֹ אַל־ תָּ֝פֵ֗ק יָר֥וּמוּ סֶֽלָה׃ רֹ֥אשׁ מְסִבָּ֑י עֲמַ֖ל שְׂפָתֵ֣ימוֹ יְכַסּוּמוֹ׃

passages.text: May burning coals fall on them; may they be thrown into the fire, into the miry pits, never to rise again.
passages.sermon:
God is the judge.
God punishes the wicked.
Burning coals fall on the wicked.
Fire destroys them.
God throws them into deep, muddy pits.
They do not rise again.
passages.original: יָמִיטוּ עֲלֵיהֶ֗ם גֶּֽחָ֫לִ֥ים בָּאֵ֥שׁ יַפִּלֵ֑ם בְּ֝מַהֲמֹר֗וֹת בַּֽל־ יָקֽוּמוּ׃

passages.text: May no slanderer be established in the land; may calamity hunt down the man of violence.
passages.sermon:
A slanderer speaks lies about others.
A slanderer will not stand firm in the land.
A violent man does evil.
Calamity will pursue the violent man.
Calamity will drive him to ruin.
passages.original: אִ֥ישׁ לָשׁוֹן֮ בַּל־ יִכּ֪וֹן בָּ֫אָ֥רֶץ אִישׁ־ חָמָ֥ס רָ֑ע יְ֝צוּדֶ֗נּוּ לְמַדְחֵפֹֽת׃

passages.text: I know that the LORD upholds justice for the poor and defends the cause of the needy.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is just.
The LORD cares for the poor.
The LORD defends the needy.
I know this is true.
passages.original: יָדַעְתִּ כִּֽי־ יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה יְ֭הוָה דִּ֣ין עָנִ֑י מִ֝שְׁפַּ֗ט אֶבְיֹנִֽים׃

passages.text: Surely the righteous will praise Your name; the upright will dwell in Your presence.
passages.sermon: The righteous will praise Your name.\r\nThe upright will dwell in Your presence.
passages.original: אַ֣ךְ צַ֭דִּיקִים יוֹד֣וּ לִשְׁמֶ֑ךָ יֵשְׁב֥וּ יְ֝שָׁרִ֗ים אֶת־ פָּנֶֽיךָ׃
